Geometry of 1523-PF-panel-frame, probed from peli/1520/1523-PF-panel-frame.STEP

Written by tools/kb/geom_probe.py, not hand edited, so that a CAD model's measurable
facts can be searched and reviewed as text instead of living only in whoever opened the
model that day. Units: unknown. EVERY NUMBER IS A MEASUREMENT OF THIS FILE, NOT A
SPECIFICATION: a vendor model may carry a connector, an antenna or a mounting boss the
catalogue dimension leaves out, and it may be exported in any orientation. Where the
manufacturer publishes a drawing, the drawing wins and this is how to find the number
to check against it.
